notes: Fixes a rare stall where drift correction could stop applying mid-recording even with the sensor at rest, if the correction estimate itself had drifted (e.g. after a long touch-and-go set with no true pause) - a safety net now forces resync from raw sensor stillness alone. Also raises the flat-guard velocity ceiling default to 0.20 m/s. Requires app v3.11.5 or later - the Bluetooth Config packet changed size.
